job.title: Procurement Specialist
job.description:
Procurement Specialist
Brisbane | Permanent Full-Time
$160k–$180k package + bonus + corporate benefits

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced Procurement Specialist to join a leading resources organisation supporting multiple mining operations across Queensland and New South Wales.

Reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will manage end-to-end procurement activities across Labour (Trades) and Services categories, driving strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier performance and commercial value delivery.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing sourcing strategies through spend and market analysis
  • Leading tendering, negotiations and contract implementation
  • Managing supplier relationships and contract performance
  • Partnering with operational stakeholders across the business
  • Delivering cost savings and continuous improvement outcomes

To be successful, you will bring:

  • Strong procurement and contract negotiation experience
  • Mining, resources or heavy industry exposure highly regarded
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and commercial capability
  • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications, with CIPS highly desirable

Brisbane based role, with Newcastle also considered for the right candidate.

job.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
job.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Advisor to support General Goods and Services procurement within a strategic procurement team. Reporting to the Procurement Manager, this role will deliver end-to-end procurement and contract management advice while partnering closely with internal stakeholders.

Key focus areas

  • End-to-end procurement across sourcing, tendering, contracting and supplier management

  • Preparing and managing tenders, evaluations, negotiations and contract awards

  • Providing strategic procurement advice and ensuring compliance with public sector policy and governance

  • Supporting continuous improvement and value-for-money outcomes

About you

  • 4+ years’ experience in end-to-end procurement

  • Strong tendering and contract negotiation experience

  • Knowledge of public sector procurement frameworks highly regarded

  • Confident stakeholder engagement and communication skills

  • CIPS or equivalent desirable, not essential

This is an initial 12-month contract with strong potential to become permanent.

job.title: Senior Commercial Advisor
job.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Advisor to join our clients high-performing team. In this role, you’ll shape some of the country’s most complex and high-profile water and infrastructure projects – from early investment decisions and business case development through to procurement, contract execution, and delivery.

 

Responsibilities include:
  • Provide strategic commercial and transaction advice across the full asset lifecycle.
  • Support government clients on complex procurements, including business cases, commercial models, market engagement, and contract negotiations.
  • Lead or contribute to procurement strategy, bid evaluation, and transaction management.
  • Build and review financial models, conduct commercial analysis, and assess value-for-money outcomes.
  • Draft and review commercial principles, contracts, and negotiate to achieve strong results.
  • Engage with government, delivery partners, and stakeholders to build trusted relationships.
  • Identify and manage risks while ensuring strong governance and probity.

 

To be successful you will have:
  • Tertiary qualifications in a relevant field.
  • 5–10 years’ experience in commercial advisory, transaction management, or procurement, ideally in water or major infrastructure projects.
  • Strong skills in financial modelling, negotiation, and commercial analysis.
  • Proven ability to develop business cases and commercial advice.
  • A background in consulting or the public sector is highly regarded.
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

job.title: ICT Category Manager
job.description:
Looking to take the next step in your ICT procurement career?

We’re seeking a ICT Category Manager to support the delivery of ICT category strategies across a complex and regulated environment. Reporting to a Senior Manager, this role offers hands-on exposure to end-to-end procurement, contract management and supplier engagement—backed by strong mentoring and development.

What you’ll be doing:
• Supporting ICT category planning and sourcing activities
• Assisting with tenders, evaluations and contract documentation
• Monitoring supplier performance and supporting contract management
• Analysing spend and market data to identify opportunities
• Working closely with stakeholders to deliver compliant, value-driven outcomes

About you:
• 2–5 years’ experience in procurement, sourcing or contract management
• Exposure to ICT or technology-related categories
• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder engagement skills
• Keen to develop your commercial and category management capability

Why apply?
• Exposure to complex ICT procurement
• Supportive, development-focused environment
• Flexible working arrangements

Interested? Apply now.
